To the left, an elegant xenomorph, her biomechanical form glowing in a dim light, sits on a bar stool. He wears a form-fitting uniform with a short, high collar and a single vertical stripe on the jacket. His hair is neatly styled with a clean, mid-century part. Behind the bar, in the center of the image, an imposing, anthropomorphic octopus-like alien bartender stands upright, his tentacles subtly arranged to mimic human arms while he holds a glass, wearing a crisp white shirt and smart trousers, his multifaceted eyes glaring in displeasure with a distinctly human scowl. Behind the bartender, a mirrored wall reflects rows of liquor bottles with geometric labels. Above the bar floats a neon sign made of curved glass tubes that reads 'COSMIC LOUNGE' in tall, rounded letters, emitting light with a soft, glowing halo. An illuminated menu board reads 'SIGNATURE DRINKS' with three items: 'ORBITAL HIGHBALL,' 'NEBULA SOUR,' and 'ROCKET MARTINI,' each displayed on glowing horizontal bars. An illuminated sign reading 'GALAXY BAR SERVICE' encircles the inner rim of the dome in capitals and dominates the left side of the frame. Soft lighting reflects off the glass and acrylic surfaces, highlighting the structural design.

nodes.title: Z-Image Total Fun Workflow: README
widgets_values:
## Ink Sketch

This is an experimental workflow for generating images with various ink and pencil sketch styles.

## Parameters

__seed__
* The initial number for random generation. Each unique seed produces a different image.
* Results in significantly more dramatic variations when __"turbo_creativity"__ is turned on.

__style__
* The visual style that defines the overall look of your final image.

__palette__
* The color palette to use. This acts as a guide and is not always strictly followed in the final generated image.

__imprint_style_label__
* Prints the name of the selected style directly onto the image.
* It is recommended to leave this disabled by default.

__prompt__
* The text description of what you want to see, including subjects, actions, and settings.
* Avoid style keywords such as photo, comic, or blur, as the selected styles handle all visual effects automatically.

__steps__
* The number of iterations performed during the denoising process.
* The optimal setting is 8 steps. Increase this value only if you require better quality or need to fix minor hallucinations caused by __"turbo_creativity"__, keeping in mind that higher step counts result in longer render times.

__initial_bias__
* Adjusts the starting noise deviation to correct color issues, brightness, or even weird hallucinations.
* 0.0 serves as the optimal setting and is generally best left unchanged due to its unpredictable effects.

__turbo_creativity__
* Shakes up the generation process to produce unique, original compositions and avoid generic AI aesthetics.
* It is prone to generating hallucinations and duplicate elements, especially in high-contrast images.
* Disable this feature if you require highly precise and complex images.
* Enable this feature when exploring creative compositions with substantial variations between different seeds.
* Working with __turbo_creativity__ involves testing multiple seeds until you find the ideal one.
* Some minor defects and small hallucinations can be corrected by tweaking __"steps"__ and __"initial_bias"__.
* Note that seed numbers that are multiples of 3 cause __turbo_creativity__ to hallucinate more frequently, as the sampler internally skips one correction step to maximize image variation.

__detailed_sampling__
* Applies a different sampling method during the final steps to add finer details, although it may increase the generation time.

__contrast__
* Controls how smooth or intense the brightness transitions appear in the final image.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__color__
* Adjusts the color saturation of the image.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__hue__
* Modifies the color tint, primarily used to calibrate skin tones.
* 0.0 serves as the neutral baseline.

__orientation__
* Sets the orientation of the final image, where vertical creates a portrait format and horizontal creates a landscape format.

__aspect_ratio__
* Determines the proportional relationship between the width and height of the final image.

__ck_attention__
* Enables Comfy-Kitchen attention to reduce generation time. This takes effect only in newer versions of ComfyUI that support this optimization.

__zimage_turbo_ckpt__
* The checkpoint file used for the Z-Image Turbo diffusion model.

__qwen3_4b_ckpt__
* The checkpoint file used as text encoder, which must be based on the Qwen3-4b model.

__vae__
* The checkpoint file used for the variational autoencoder.

## Created by Martin Rizzo
* GitHub : https://github.com/martin-rizzo
* CivitAI: https://civitai.com/user/Photographer
* Reddit : https://www.reddit.com/user/FotografoVirtual

>>> Colored Pencil Sketch
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a conceptual designer capturing the initial material and volume study of a project on heavy, cold-pressed toothy paper. 
Your work is a sophisticated exploratory sketch: precise yet energetic, focused on defining form through layered color density and varying pressure. The image is built upon faint, gestural graphite under-drawings, over which translucent, waxy colored pencil strokes are applied to suggest curvature, material sheen, and atmospheric light.
The style embraces the "tooth" of the paper, where the pigment sits beautifully within the grain, creating a soft, grainy texture. Lines are not just outlines; they are descriptive contours that describe the object's mass. You utilize cross-hatching and pressure-sensitive layering to build up shadows and highlights. The colors are blended with artistic intent—overlapping hues to create secondary tones—rather than bleeding carelessly. There is an organic, tactile quality to the marks, with occasional white highlights sharpened by a prismacolor finish. It is a refined, illustrative process that captures the soul and material essence of the design before it reaches digital rendering.
{$IFPAL
The color palette acts as a study of materials: $1 for the brightest light catches, $2 for the primary local color of the object, and $3 for deep, rich shadow transitions, with $4 often used to outline key structural details. |
The color application is a rich blend of warm and cool tones, building volume through layered strokes that respect the tactile, abrasive quality of high-quality sketchbook paper.
}
{$**@@ The sketch has an expressive and intimate tone, while the female characters feature overtly voluptuous and alluring bodies, dressed in form-fitting attire, with seductive and mischievous expressions. }
YOUR SKETCH:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Rash Concept Draft
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a manic concept artist capturing a fleeting, urgent spark of inspiration on a scrap of textured, cold-pressed paper. 
Your work is NOT a finished illustration, but a raw, unrefined draft. The aesthetic is defined by high-energy, gestural execution: errant, shaky lines and overlapping construction marks that ignore clinical precision to embrace chaotic creativity.
The medium is heavily reliant on the physical properties of colored pencils; long, sweeping wax-like strokes overlap with crude, scribbled hatchings. The pigment is applied with varying, inconsistent pressure, causing colors to bleed slightly outside the initial sketched boundaries. The "tooth" of the paper is aggressively engaged, resulting in a rough, grainy surface where the carbon and wax mix with visible smudges and "corrected" lines. Volume is suggested not through precise shading, but through energetic, directional marks that convey motion and raw tactile energy rather than polished form.
{$IFPAL
The chaotic color application utilizes $1 for intense, bright flashes of light or focal energy, $2 for the dominant local masses, and $3 for deep, heavy shadow strokes, with $4 often appearing as sharp, linear accents or corrections. |
The scene is colored with a rugged, high-contrast palette where warm and cool tones clash and blend erratically, emphasizing the rough, abrasive texture of the sketchbook paper over color accuracy.
}
{$**@@ The sketch has an expressive and intimate tone, while the female characters feature overtly voluptuous and alluring bodies, dressed in form-fitting attire, with seductive and mischievous expressions. }
YOUR SKETCH:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Dark Ballpoint Sketch
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are an obsessed illustrator creating a dark, gothic piece on aged, slightly yellowed paper. The subject is distorted with a macabre and unsettling tone: elongated limbs, deep-set hollow eyes, and sharp, angular anatomy.
The rendering is stark and high-contrast, utilizing the "stabbing" technique of a ballpoint pen. Use clusters of short, neurotic, and jagged vertical lines to create a sense of decay and nervous tension. Shadows are not smooth; they are aggressive, deep, and claustrophobic, concentrated only in the recesses and corners of the anatomy. The negative space is critical here—large areas of the subject should be left completely untouched, making the ink-heavy areas feel like an encroaching, dark sickness spreading across the page. The overall feeling is one of Victorian-era dread, sharp, brittle, and morbid.
{$IFPAL
The darkness is layered using $1 for deep, suffocating shadows and $2 for brittle, scratchy textures, while $3 highlights the most disturbing, grotesque details. |
The drawing is entirely monochromatic blue ballpoint pen, focusing on the high contrast between dense, frantic clusters of blue ink and the vast, empty, haunting white space of the page.
}
{$**@@ The sketch has a dark and sexual tone, while the female characters feature overtly voluptuous and alluring bodies, dressed in form-fitting attire, with seductive and mischievous expressions. }
YOUR SKETCH:
<!--
{$@}

>>> Animation Sketch Concept
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are an animation artist sketching a character's "first pass" on a clean, professional storyboard sheet. The style is quintessentially Disney-inspired: characterized by fluid, expressive, and exaggerated curvilinear forms, soft rounded anatomy, and dynamic, clean silhouettes.
Despite the professional character design, the medium is strictly a standard blue ballpoint pen. The line work is bouncy and confident, featuring long, sweeping curves that define the form, with "tapered" ends where the pen lifts from the page. Use sparse, elegant cross-hatching only in small, strategic pockets to suggest volume. The majority of the paper remains empty, emphasizing the clean, iconic silhouette of the character. The aesthetic is charming, polished in intent but raw in execution, with occasional light pencil guidelines still visible underneath the ink.
{$IFPAL
The ink strokes transition between $1 for soft shadows and $2 for clean contour lines, with $3 used only for the most expressive facial focal points. |
The drawing relies on varying line weight and clean, energetic curves, using a monochromatic blue ink to emphasize the expressive, "bouncy" animation style.
}
{$**@@ The sketch has a provocative and sensual tone. The female characters have voluptuous bodies and wear tight clothing. }
YOUR SKETCH:
<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Sensual Pencil Sketch
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a master of the adult European graphic novel, celebrated for your ability to capture feminine allure, playful eroticism, and the art of the tease through the intimate medium of a pencil sketch.
Your style is a sophisticated exploratory sketch on heavy, cold-pressed toothy paper. The image is a provocative graphite drawing built upon faint, gestural under-drawings and layered line density with varying pressure that celebrates the human form with rhythmic grace. 
The poses are dynamic and suggestive, capturing moments of intimate tension, flirtatious mischief, and an air of sophisticated provocation. You emphasize expressive, seductive glances and the subtle tension of the body using descriptive contours, cross-hatching, and pressure-sensitive shading. The overall mood is a perfect balance between artistic elegance and daring sensuality, capturing the tactile and organic quality of a master's sketchbook.
{$IFPAL
The coloring is minimalist, using translucent, waxy colored pencil strokes with soft, $1 tints, using $2 for the primary color of objects, and $4 for heavy shadow strokes, without hiding the crisp graphite outlines. |
The coloring is minimalist, using translucent, waxy colored pencil strokes with soft, skin-warming tints that embrace the grain of the paper without hiding the crisp graphite outlines. .
}

<!--
{$@}
-->


>>> Sensual Anime Pencil Sketch
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a master of sensual anime and manga illustration, capturing feminine allure and playful eroticism through a raw, unpolished preliminary storyboard.
Your style is a loose, messy rough sketch on manuscript paper, featuring visible trial-and-error construction lines and hasty corrections. The image is a provocative graphite drawing built upon heavy gestural under-drawings and erratic line density.
The poses are dynamic and suggestive, capturing intimate tension and mischievous provocation. You emphasize large seductive eyes, messy hair, and body tension using broken contours, frantic cross-hatching, and aggressive shading. The overall mood balances Japanese aesthetic elegance with daring sensuality, capturing a mangaka's raw concept notebook.
{$IFPAL
The coloring uses erratic, translucent pencil smudges with soft $1 tints, using $2 for hair and eyes, and $4 for heavy shadow strokes, blending haphazardly over the messy graphite outlines. |
The coloring uses translucent, careless pencil smudges with soft skin-warming tints that embrace the paper grain without erasing messy under-drawings.
}
{$**@@ The sketch has a pure sexual tone, with female characters featuring overtly voluptuous and alluring bodies, large nude breasts, and seductive expressions. }

{$@}

>>> Cute Ballpoint Sketch
YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a young, imaginative child drawing with a ballpoint pen on a crumpled, cheap notebook page. The style is profoundly naive, innocent, and lacks any understanding of formal perspective or anatomy. 
The subject is simplified into basic, blocky symbols—the head is a shaky circle, the limbs are simple lines with rounded ends. The ink work is unsteady and repetitive, with loops, scribbles that go outside the intended lines, and "accidental" pressure marks where the hand lingered too long on the paper. The composition is unbalanced, often floating in the center of the page with wide margins of raw, empty paper surrounding it. Use a "broken" line style where the pen occasionally skips, leaving small gaps, creating a sense of genuine, unrefined playfulness.
{$IFPAL
The drawing is entirely monochromatic $3 and $4 lines, featuring wobbly, inconsistent lines and simple, childlike geometric reductions of the subject, leaving most of the paper starkly blank. |
The drawing is entirely monochromatic blue ballpoint pen, featuring wobbly, inconsistent lines and simple, childlike geometric reductions of the subject, leaving most of the paper starkly blank.
}

YOUR CONTEXT:
You are a child aged 5‑7, drawing with crayons, colored pencils, or markers on a slightly crumpled sheet of paper.  
Your illustration captures the pure, spontaneous energy of a kid’s doodle: loose, uneven lines, simple geometric shapes, exaggerated expressions, and a palette of bright primary colors (red, blue, yellow) mixed with occasional pastel scribbles. The artwork feels happy, naïve, and delightfully imperfect—no need for precise anatomy or perspective, just raw imagination.

>>> Technical Schematic Draft
